skills.name: Prompt Chaining
skills.when_to_use: Decompose ordered stages so each LLM call feeds the next.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip for independent or intent-branched work.

skills.name: Routing
skills.when_to_use: Classify intent, then send work to one specialist.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip when every request shares one linear path.

skills.name: Parallelization
skills.when_to_use: Run independent workers together, then merge grounded.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip when step B needs step A's output.

skills.name: Reflection
skills.when_to_use: Loop generate → critique → revise until a stop token.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip one-shot tasks with no evaluator.

skills.name: Tool Use
skills.when_to_use: Call APIs, code, search, or side effects via function calling.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip for closed-book generation.

skills.name: Planning
skills.when_to_use: Write a step plan, then execute interdependent operations.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip single-tool or single-prompt jobs.

skills.name: Multi-Agent Collaboration
skills.when_to_use: Split work across specialized in-process agents.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip if one agent plus tools is enough.

skills.name: Memory Management
skills.when_to_use: Persist session state and cross-session facts.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip stateless one-shots.

skills.name: Learning and Adaptation
skills.when_to_use: Change policy or code from evaluation signals.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip frozen prompts that only need one-off critique.

skills.name: Model Context Protocol
skills.when_to_use: Discover and call evolving remote tools/resources.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip for a few hard-coded local functions.

skills.name: Goal Setting and Monitoring
skills.when_to_use: Iterate toward SMART goals until a judge says True.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip when success is undefined.

skills.name: Exception Handling and Recovery
skills.when_to_use: Retry, fallback, or degrade when tools/networks fail.
skills.when_not_to_use: Do not mask prompt bugs with retries.

skills.name: Human-in-the-Loop
skills.when_to_use: Escalate or confirm before irreversible or ambiguous acts.
skills.when_not_to_use: Do not block high-volume low-risk turns.

skills.name: Knowledge Retrieval (RAG)
skills.when_to_use: Answer from a private or fresh corpus: retrieve then generate.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip closed-book trivia.

skills.name: Inter-Agent Communication (A2A)
skills.when_to_use: Let heterogeneous agents discover and task each other over HTTP.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip in-process SequentialAgent teams.

skills.name: Resource-Aware Optimization
skills.when_to_use: Pick cheaper/faster models unless complexity requires more.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip when one model already meets SLA and budget.

skills.name: Reasoning Techniques
skills.when_to_use: Force CoT/ToT/ReAct/self-correction on hard problems.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip trivial lookups.

skills.name: Guardrails / Safety
skills.when_to_use: Validate inputs, outputs, and tool args with layered policy.
skills.when_not_to_use: Do not rely on a permissive LLM-only gate.

skills.name: Evaluation and Monitoring
skills.when_to_use: Score quality, latency, tokens, and drift in production.
skills.when_not_to_use: Do not use exact-match as the only metric.

skills.name: Prioritization
skills.when_to_use: Rank competing tasks by urgency, value, and dependencies.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip for a single linear job.

skills.name: Exploration and Discovery
skills.when_to_use: Seek unknown unknowns: hypothesize, test, multi-review.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip known-answer Q&A.
